mapper.select: SELECT e.*, c.title as courseTitle FROM exam e LEFT JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam (title, course_id, duration, total_score, pass_score, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{courseId}, #{duration}, #{totalScore}, #{passScore}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE exam SET title = #{title}, course_id = #{courseId}, duration = #{duration}, total_score = #{totalScore}, pass_score = #{passScore}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
